stories.title: FMs of Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye Condemn Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: FMs of Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye Condemn Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, and Türkiye issued a joint condemnation of Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Zelenskiy Says He Discussed Energy Truce, Efforts to End Russia War with Trump

en.title: Zelenskiy Says He Discussed Energy Truce, Efforts to End Russia War with Trump
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskiy stated that he discussed an energy ceasefire and ways to conclude the conflict with Russia in conversations with Trump.

stories.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Putin discuss regional escalation, maritime security

en.title: Saudi Crown Prince, Putin discuss regional escalation, maritime security
en.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Russian President Vladimir Putin held a phone call to discuss regional developments and their effects on international maritime security.

stories.title: Zelensky says ready to halt energy site strikes if Russia reciprocates

en.title: Zelensky says ready to halt energy site strikes if Russia reciprocates
en.summary: Ukrainian President Zelensky announced Ukraine's willingness to cease strikes on Russian energy infrastructure if Russia agrees to stop attacking Ukrainian energy systems, with hopes to end the war before winter.

stories.title: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia ensuring peace and building a common future

en.title: Turkiye, Saudi Arabia ensuring peace and building a common future
en.summary: Turkiye and Saudi Arabia are marking the centenary of their diplomatic relations established in 1926. The two countries are building on their historical ties and shared interests to strengthen their relationship.

stories.title: Hundreds on hunger strike in Lebanon prison as amnesty stalled

en.title: Hundreds on hunger strike in Lebanon prison as amnesty stalled
en.summary: Hundreds of inmates in a Lebanese prison have been on a ten-day hunger strike over delays in implementing an amnesty law passed by parliament last month. The law aims to benefit thousands of prisoners and wanted individuals.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense

en.title: Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Pakistan, Türkiye condemn attacks on Kingdom, back right to self-defense
en.summary: Foreign ministers from four nations condemned all attacks on Saudi Arabia, including recent Houthi strikes, and reaffirmed support for the Kingdom's sovereignty and legal right to defend itself during UN General Assembly consultations.

stories.title: Bahraini Speaker: Saudi Arabia Remains Main Pillar of Regional Security, Stability

en.title: Bahraini Speaker: Saudi Arabia Remains Main Pillar of Regional Security, Stability
en.summary: Bahrain's Speaker stated that Saudi Arabia plays a central role in maintaining regional security and stability.

stories.title: Arab-Islamic ministers deplore Israeli move to consolidate annexation in Palestine

en.title: Arab-Islamic ministers deplore Israeli move to consolidate annexation in Palestine
en.summary: Foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia and seven other Arab and Islamic states rejected measures involving Palestinian displacement and opposed Israeli actions including settlement expansion and land confiscation in occupied territories.

stories.title: Saudi King Hails Forces Defending Kingdom, Condemns Houthi Attempts to Target Makkah

en.title: Saudi King Hails Forces Defending Kingdom, Condemns Houthi Attempts to Target Makkah
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's King commended military and security forces for defending the Kingdom and condemned Houthi attempts to target Makkah.

stories.title: Saudi FM joins regional quartet in New York talks on de-escalation, security

en.title: Saudi FM joins regional quartet in New York talks on de-escalation, security
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister participated in a meeting with officials from Pakistan, Egypt and Türkiye at the United Nations General Assembly to discuss regional tensions and security matters.

stories.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint

en.title: UN condemns continued Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, urges restraint
en.summary: The United Nations condemned ongoing Houthi cross-border attacks against Saudi Arabia, including attempted strikes on Riyadh and attacks on civilians and energy infrastructure, and called for restraint from all parties.

stories.title: ‎Tawrid CEO says banks, NBFIs to provide liquidity via platform

en.title: Tawrid CEO says banks, NBFIs to provide liquidity via platform
en.summary: The CEO of Tawrid Company for Financing Solutions stated that banks and non-banking financial institutions will supply liquidity through the platform to finance suppliers. Tawrid operates as an intermediary connecting suppliers, buyers, and financing institutions without using its own capital or assuming financing risks.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia denies claims it bought 25 oil tankers

en.title: Saudi Arabia denies claims it bought 25 oil tankers
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy refuted allegations that the Kingdom purchased 25 oil tankers, stating the information was incorrect. The denial responded to Iraqi officials who had claimed the tanker purchases contributed to increased transportation costs for Iraqi oil.

stories.title: ‎King Salman condemns Houthi militia’s repeated attempt to target Makkah

en.title: King Salman condemns Houthi militia's repeated attempt to target Makkah
en.summary: King Salman condemned the Houthi militia's repeated attempts to target Makkah during a Cabinet session, calling the actions a heinous crime that violates holy site sanctity and provokes Muslim sentiment worldwide.

stories.title: ‎SVCP shareholders to vote on 69.71% capital cut on Oct. 22

en.title: SVCP shareholders to vote on 69.71% capital cut on Oct. 22
en.summary: Saudi Vitrified Clay Pipes Co. will hold a shareholder vote on October 22 to reduce capital by 69.71%, from SAR 150 million to SAR 45.43 million, to offset accumulated losses of SAR 104.57 million.

stories.title: ‎Rawasi Albina files lawsuits against former CEO, Chairman

en.title: Rawasi Albina files lawsuits against former CEO, Chairman
en.summary: Rawasi Albina Investment Co. has filed a lawsuit against former Managing Director and CEO Meteb Alotaibi and Chairman Abdullah Alotaibi, seeking precautionary attachment on properties mortgaged to the company during a review of the former director's tenure.
